name: Stygian-Zij
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by binary sunset (multiple suns), and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.

For traders, helium-3, nitrogen, dark crystals and water alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
